pack: Gridwright Isometric City People - Free Sample
grid: made for the 32x16 isometric ground diamond of Gridwright Isometric City (and Isometric Tiles, Interiors, Wasteland); people are about 22 px tall at 1x, the city's storey is 20 px; sizes and points are at 1x
placement: the anchor on the centre of the cell (col, row) at height h: x = X0 + 16 (col - row), y = Y0 + 8 (col + row) + 8 - h; draw the frame at (x - anchor x, y - anchor y)
draw_order: draw the ground first, then sort people with objects by col + row of the cell under the anchor
row_note: every sheet has one row per direction in this order: s = towards the viewer, then clockwise; every direction is drawn, none is mirrored
shadows: Effects/<k>x/shadow_small.png (16x16, one flat colour, anchor at the centre): draw it under the anchor at about 35% opacity; no frame has a baked shadow
animations_note: idle 4 frames 6 fps, walk 8 frames 10 fps (walk_speed in each Sheets JSON keeps the feet planted), phone 4 frames 4 fps (talking on a phone)
